en: Added Claude apps gateway startup warnings when a managed policy's `availableModels` is empty, or leaves out the model Claude Code starts on without setting `model` or `enforceAvailableModels`
zh: 当托管策略的 `availableModels` 为空，或未设置 `model` 或 `enforceAvailableModels` 却遗漏了 Claude Code 启动时使用的模型时，新增 Claude 应用网关启动警告
